title: Late-Express Credit Computation, Northgate Store and Online Orders
content:
**Clause.** On a Northgate Same-Day Delivery express order of **Northgate Store and Online Orders**, the standard late-express credit is half (50 percent) of the express delivery fee charged on the order, rounded half up to the cent.

The late-express credit percentage is the late-express lateness rate of one half together with every extra percentage on the order. The express delivery fee charged is multiplied once by that percentage, any flat amount on the order is added, the sum is rounded half up to the cent, and the credit never exceeds the express delivery fee standing on the order, that is the fee charged less refunds already booked against it. Every count of calendar days in this computation leaves out the day it starts from and includes the day it ends on.

**Worked figures (hypothetical express fees).**
- An express fee charged at 17.00 with nothing refunded: half of 17.00 is 8.50, so the credit is 8.50.
- An express fee charged at 17.00 with 12.00 already refunded against it: the fee standing is 5.00, so the credit is 5.00.
